# Subclass 309 Grant Horizon — Swiss Cheese AI

Canonical URL: https://visa.swisscheeseai.au/

This site provides a statistical planning model for estimating a likely Australian Partner (Provisional) visa subclass 309 decision window from processing-time benchmarks.

Key facts:
- Free web tool.
- Results are estimates, not guarantees.
- It is not an official Department of Home Affairs decision predictor.
- The tool models a likely timing window from benchmark inputs.

Primary source: https://visa.swisscheeseai.au/
Sitemap: https://visa.swisscheeseai.au/sitemap.xml
